title: Influence
statement: For a real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube of dimension $n$ and a coordinate $i$, the influence of coordinate $i$ is the uniform expectation over $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$ of the square of the discrete derivative of $f$ in coordinate $i$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
$i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
